title: LLM Provider Registry
description: Infrastructure-level configuration for LLM providers. Contains endpoint, auth, and model catalog. Must not contain role assignments.

type.description: Provider type. cloud_api = OpenAI-compatible HTTP API. local_ollama = local Ollama service.

endpoint_env.description: Environment variable name that holds the base URL for this provider.

auth_env.description: Environment variable name that holds the API key. Omit for local providers that require no auth.

available_models.description: Whitelist of valid model names for this provider. Both primary and secondary models must appear here.
